standing_user_instructions.origin_watchdog: Run once each research turn; reuse hash-bound original-history anchors, compare the current research object and claims with both original motives, and make the smallest substantive correction. Do not substitute repeated administrative auditing for derivation or implementation.
standing_user_instructions.authorization: User has authorized scoped research, per-stage backup and publishing. Do not ask again for routine reversible continuation.
standing_user_instructions.no_unbounded_automation: No unattended schedule or C26 execution was created in this turn.

retained_findings.incumbent_preservation: derived, implementation-verified and finite TEST checked
retained_findings.declared_work_price_stop: derived sufficient condition for fixed complete actions and actual mandatory-readout charge floor
retained_findings.wall_time_stop: empirical; TRAIN point prediction is not a universal lower bound

retained_findings.original_targets: Full MCTS, Gomoku P2, P3 and production P4 remain unresolved

selected_next_question: Can the retained-incumbent and priced-STOP contracts be implemented through existing GameState root-action intervals with correct root-player semantics, complete candidate coverage and measured search/control costs?
why_next: Reconnect the verified STOP/FOCUS mechanism to the original actual-game objective. C25 G is a worst-case gain ceiling, not an expected or attainable gain model; do not infer profitable continuation from failure of its sufficient stop test.

scope.game_class: finite deterministic two-player zero-sum perfect-information GameState
scope.initial_fixture: existing TicTacToe 3x3 via reachable legal histories from initial state
scope.value: outcome() is current-player perspective; v_root = p_root*p_state*outcome(state), u=(v_root+1)/2
scope.intervals: terminal exact root utilities; unexpanded values remain [-1,1] in v units; complete max/min interval backups
scope.candidate_coverage: retain every legal root action or an explicit bound for all omitted root candidates
scope.runtime_oracle_boundary: exact minimax is offline evaluation only
scope.controller: generic game-independent safe switch and sufficient priced stop; account for actual expansion/backup/controller work
scope.existing_Bayes_reference: Reuse finite_metalevel.rs if comparing expected VOC; it is not SearchPolicy and does not calibrate neural MCTS
scope.cost_semantics: derive a positive deterministic charge floor for the actual implemented next computation; wall-time claims require separate evidence
scope.transposition: preserve all GameState history relevant to outcome and identity; do not infer universal board-only sufficiency
non_claims: No Gomoku P2 completion from TicTacToe
No inference that G > price*cost implies useful computation

theory_loop.output: Recover final C25 identity, run origin watchdog, map C25 decisions to existing GameState and explicit game-value target.
Reuse relevant metareasoning/interval-search literature; resolve only new load-bearing minimax/backup conditions with primary sources.
Fix root-player signs, utility normalization, legal complete action set, finite tree/horizon, state identity and output contract.
Construct terminal, alternating-player, tie, missed-candidate and overlapping-bound examples; compare safe retention with ordinary reselection.
Prove interval backup validity, nested refinement, incumbent preservation and priced-continuation condition for the actual computation class.
Independently check signs, free versus paid selection, transposition/coverage assumptions and theorem limits.
Execute exact finite game-tree discriminating calculations against offline minimax; preserve counterexamples.
Choose the constructive bridge or narrow it based on evidence; classify any failure without turning a local limitation into a universal no-go.
Freeze cohort/splits, baselines, cost units/prices, primary metric, stopping rule and code-ready contract before fresh evaluation.
Close the ten theory stages with claim ledger and implementation handoff; keep original game/CPU targets explicit.

coding_loop.output: Inspect actual repository interfaces/environment; create isolated branch/worktree and objective acceptance criteria.
Map root-value definitions, backup equations and stopping conditions to GameState code, public inputs and independent oracle outputs.
Specify exact integer/rational utility handling, signs, budgets, deterministic charge counters and timing boundaries.
Freeze sequential run DAG, one timing worker, source chunking and per-stage preservation plan.
Implement minimal generic controller through existing GameState; keep offline minimax outside runtime inputs.
Execute changed-behavior tests for signs, terminal/tie cases, complete candidates, unknown inputs, safe switches and budget returns.
Validate exact interval/utility invariants; train any empirical cost model only on TRAIN and freeze before heldout observations.
Run the fixed fresh cohort and actual timing/count comparisons; report utility preservation, missed improvements, regret and full net cost.
One fresh bounded independent source/proof/raw-result review plus actual backup restore; no recursive audit campaign.
Publish final findings and exact reproduction/provenance; map achieved game bridge to remaining neural/MCTS and Gomoku obligations.

stop_conditions: Any invalid interval, omitted candidate without a bound, root-player sign mismatch, or oracle runtime leakage blocks the corresponding claim and must be fixed before heldout execution.
Negative net benefit is preserved as a scientific outcome, not used to retune TEST.
Complete the selected twenty-stage cycle, then report the next stage without silently launching another cycle.

claim_gates.bridge: Exact oracle containment, initial utility nondecrease, actual-cost accounting and independent reconstruction on legal reachable game states.
claim_gates.economic: Predeclared source-paired net benefit or budget/quality comparison; no substitution of an easier baseline after results.
claim_gates.original_P2: Requires actual Gomoku7x7 paired game-quality and nn_evals_per_move evidence under the original fairness condition; C26 bridge alone cannot satisfy it.
